title: Somebody Toucha My Spaghet
blurb: Outrage on behalf of violated pasta, and a foundational text of absurdist internet humour. The clip belongs to the golden age of YouTube Poop, when editors took footage nobody remembered and looped it until it achieved a kind of nonsense transcendence. This is the one that survived. Nobody has ever satisfactorily explained why it remains funny, and a meme could hardly ask for a better compliment than that. Play it when anyone touches anything of yours: a chair, a charger, a drink you had clearly not finished. Somebody toucha my spaghet.
origin: From the classic 'somebody toucha my spaghet' meme.
